headline.title: Flooding closes Vellmoor's main bridge
headline.dek: The River Vell reached a record 4.2 metres: about 200 homes flooded and three people were taken to hospital.

scenes.question: What do we know so far?
scenes.why: People were hurt, so no memes: the megathread lists the facts and how the river changed.

updates.what: The river has fallen to 3.1 metres
The river peaks at 4.2 metres, above the 2014 record of 3.9 metres
The River Vell bursts its banks after two days of heavy rain

scenes.question: What happens next?
scenes.why: Three dates ahead that people in the town need to plan around.

reminders.what: Applications open for the flood fund
Repairs, if needed, could take until then

scenes.question: What are people saying?
scenes.why: The mayor explains the closure; a business owner by the bridge says what the water did.

comments.speaker: Ana Brandt
comments.text: The bridge stays closed until engineers have checked every pillar... We would rather lose a week than take a risk with people's lives.

comments.speaker: Tomas Reyes
comments.role: Runs a bakery beside the bridge
comments.text: [The water reached] halfway up the counter

bottom_line: Until the bridge reopens, buses take a detour of about 25 minutes through the Hollin Road crossing.
